note: 4 rows each listed the same URL twice in `sources`. Multiplicity changed; membership did not. No chair, value or reasoning touched. Restore by setting sources back to `before`.
found_by: An over-broad duplicate assertion in migration 1602 — corpus-wide where it should have been scoped to the rows that migration touched — failed its dry run at 4. Third time on this workstream an over-broad check has surfaced a real defect (1524, 1530). The rule those established: narrow the check AND fix what it found.
why_it_matters: `sources` is voter-facing — StanceAccordion and Citations.jsx render the array, so a duplicate shows a voter the same link twice.
order_note: Two of the four had NON-ADJACENT duplicates, so a naive SELECT DISTINCT would have reordered the array. The repair rebuilds each array with unnest(...) WITH ORDINALITY + min(ord), keeping first-occurrence order (the 1549 technique).
